test_combiners_mean: test the Mean combiner that computes weighted averages of value lists
test_combiners_geometric_mean: test the GeometricMean combiner that computes weighted geometric means of values
test_combiners_multiply: test the Multiply combiner that computes weighted products of value lists
test_combiners_lnorm: test the LNorm combiner that computes L-norm aggregation with configurable p and normalization
test_combiners_smoothmax: test the SmoothMax combiner that computes smooth max or min via log-sum-exp
